content: The revelations of the Light Shears has made your brain work overtime for the past couple days and you finally came up with most likely your masterpiece.
Behold: The Light Shield! A shield that reflects light around it and creates illusionary decoys to confuse you enemies.
Every time you raise your shield, you can create 1 decoy of yourself upon blocking damage that will aggro the nearby enemies so you can reposition yourself.
Up to 2 decoys can exist at the same time. These decoys last 5 seconds before disappearing.
If you create a third decoy while there are already 2 existing, the oldest one will be removed and a new one will be placed at your current location.
But that alone doesn't turn it into a masterpiece, you also managed to repurpose the refractures of the shield to turn you invisible for a few seconds. You decide to call this a 'perfect block'
The requirements for this to happen are more strict than the decoys.
Practically, if you block damage within 1 second of raising your shield, additionally to placing a decoy, you also turn completely invisible for up to 3 seconds.
This invisibility is broken if you attack, switch what's in your hands, drop or place items, interact with blocks, and so on.
When triggering the effect, you will enter a 10 second cooldown before you can become invisible again, the decoy placement is not affected by this cooldown.
